acquisitionOrdering.note: Temporary files outside the project were used only to verify upstream bytes after the user authorization; no package, lockfile, model, WASM resource, or product source was added to the project.

resources.name: U-2-Netp ONNX model
resources.verification: Exact HTTP ranges reconstructed to the official 4,574,861-byte release size. The SHA-256 was calculated over ordered ranges and the MD5 matches rembg's declared upstream value.

resources.name: ONNX Runtime Web/WASM
resources.verification: The server honored exact byte ranges, but the reconstructed response does not match the official npm SHA-512 integrity or SHA-1 shasum. The tar stream also fails to list completely. This source response is rejected and must not be installed or packaged.

independentNpmCacheReproduction.method: In each fresh temporary npm cache, read official npm dist metadata and run npm pack onnxruntime-web@1.20.1 with --ignore-scripts and --json. No project directory, dependency, lockfile, model, WASM resource, or product source was modified.
independentNpmCacheReproduction.result: Three fresh isolated npm-cache attempts read official metadata but did not produce a tarball that could complete explicit SHA-512/SHA-1 comparison, tar listing, package metadata, and size verification. The verbose attempt reached only npm registry metadata GET 200 responses before no verifiable tarball was available.

rangeAudit.result: The registry honored byte ranges but one required range returned 28672 bytes instead of 262144; the complete archive could not be reconstructed. No concatenated stream was hashed or extracted.

independentNpmCacheReproduction.disposition: No newly downloaded artifact is approved, no SHA-256 is recorded for an unverified artifact, and Task 6.1 remains incomplete. This does not override the earlier rejected range response.

packageSizeImpact.reason: Combined packaged impact remains intentionally unmeasured because the required runtime artifact failed integrity verification and is not approved for packaging.

nextRequiredAction: A fresh Controller successor must use an independent official npm distribution path that produces a complete archive, then require official SHA-512 SRI and SHA-1 matches, a complete tar listing, package version/license inspection, SHA-256 recording, and measured package impact before completing Task 6.1. Task 6.2 remains locked until then.
